entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Th is appeal coming on for hearing this day, th e Court  following:

ORDER This appeal u/S 374 of Cr.P.C. has been filed by the appellant, against the judgement dated 09.09.2014 passed by the 9th Additional Sessions Judge, Ujjain in S.T. No.599/2013, whereby appellant has been convicted u/S 363, 366 and 376(2)(n) of IPC alongwith 5(l)/6 of the POCSO Act and sentenced him to undergo RI for 05 years with fine of Rs.1,000/-, RI for 05 years with fine of Rs.1,000/-, RI for 10 years with fine of Rs.5,000/- and RI for 10 years with fine of Rs.5,000/-
respectively with default stipulations.

As per report dated 06.05.2024 received from the Jail Superintendent, Central Jail, Ujjain, it has been mentioned that sole appellant - Rahul has been released from jail on 19.04.2021, after completion of his entire jail sentence, as awarded by the Trial Court.
Considering the aforesaid, counsel for the appellant submits that he does not wish to press this appeal on behalf of the appellant.
